The number of students participating in two startup competitions, Prince and Yuvika, from a B-school, IIT K, is 96 and 130, respectively. The total number of students participating in Prince and Yuvika from all B-schools is 252 and 270, respectively. Find the number of students of IIT K participating in the only competition, Yuvika.

properties.html:
At JMM University, the number of students who consume tea, coffee, and juice is 200, 175, and 250 respectively. Every student in the university consumes at least one tea, coffee, and juice. 150 students consume juice but not coffee. 45 students consume both tea and coffee but not juice and 35 students consume only tea. The students at the university are from one of the four states – Tamil Nadu, Bihar, Mizoram, and Punjab. The total number of students from Punjab is 125. The following information is also known.

a) Every student who consumes coffee but not tea is from Mizoram and every student from Mizoram consumes coffee but not tea.

b) Every student who consumes both tea and juice but not coffee is from Tamil Nadu and every student from Tamil Nadu consumes both tea and juice but not coffee.

c) Every student who consumes only tea or only juice is from Punjab and every student from Punjab either consumes only tea or only juice.

How many students are from Bihar?

properties.html:
In an office, the employees invest in three mutual funds named- SBI Blue Chip Fund (SB), Axis Long term Fund (AL) and Franklin Templeton Tax Savings Fund (FT). The following information is also known:

1. 46 people invested in SB while 2/5th of those who invested in both AL and FT invested in all the three funds.

2. Those who invested in only FT were 1.5 times those who only invested in SB while those who invested in more than one fund were 34.

3. 120 employees were there in the office of which 6.67% invested in none of the funds.

4. The sum of the number of the employees of invested in only SB and only AL was equal to those who invested in AL while those who invested in only SB were 2.4 times of those who invested in SB and FT but not all three funds.

How many employees invested in only FT?
